digest.component_or_area: review gates observability and audit persistence
propositions: Plan-review and code-review sidecars currently drop pass-1 evidence and scenarios fields, and do not persist the numeric block_threshold resolved at decision time.
Code-review sidecar persists only surfaced findings (blocking + advisory + coaching) and omits dropped, indeterminate, and overflow buckets.
Completion-verification emits a sidecar only on FAIL; a PASS persists only signed counts without per-criterion audit records.
All review sidecars are pruned to the most recent 10 per ticket, limiting audit history depth.

Enriched v2 sidecar schemas must capture the full four-pass record (find, verify, decide, coach) with all findings across all buckets, verification results, decision rationale, resolved block_threshold, and coaching data.
An audit read layer must return the full retained history for a ticket and its relates_to-linked code reviews, with documented CLI and MCP interfaces.
